criteria.title: Directed matcher serves every path; legacy symmetric matcher unreachable
criteria.required: directed-route-progress-v1 and no serving import of matchingLegacy.ts

criteria.title: Formal invariant enforced at runtime on every result
Unit, replay and property suites pass over all 15 invariants
Every negative control (F1, F3 leak paths, F4, fail-closed rules) is killed
criteria.observed: 139/139 killed, 0 survived, 0 stale, 0 invalid, 0 timed out; complete true, baseline green true, tree unchanged true; all 139 pinned controls killed
criteria.required: a complete run on a green baseline and an unchanged tree: all killed, none survived, stale, invalid or timed out, and each of the 139 pinned controls among the killed

criteria.title: No former live wrong commit is still a commit at its instant
criteria.required: 0 commits; legacy reproduces every recorded selection

criteria.title: Automatic matching off by default, and an opt-in refused below bounded automation
criteria.observed: off: true (configuration evaluated, no live deployment read)

criteria.title: Full-window blind replay of every retained raw live collection, legacy side reproducing the record
criteria.required: ≥ 1 collection, reproduction ok, no retained artifact left out

criteria.title: Zero wrong commits, zero invariant violations, zero non-fresh selections on live evidence
No previously correct live case regresses to wrong; no new wrong commit
Replay is deterministic across independent runs, case by case
Counterfactual suite on real bases: no expectation failure, no wrong commit, no violation
Independent live sample large enough for a 5 % bound
Independent live sample large enough for a 1 % bound, at session cadence (the envelope that would be automated)
criteria.required: at session cadence: ≥ 300 trajectories, ≥ 100 vehicles, ≥ 100 contested, ≥ 15 routes, ≥ 10 windows, ≥ 3 time bands

criteria.title: Evidence at session cadence (direct TAGO, uncached) with evaluated cases, not only the cached public path
Rider sees the automatically committed bus and can undo it (architecture response to rider-choice risk)
criteria.required: implemented and tested in the rider client

criteria.title: Destination alert timing does not depend on unmeasured provider lag
Live Activity shows the committed bus on a physical device
criteria.required: verified on hardware (a device check, not a ride)

criteria.title: How often riders board the first arriving bus is measured
criteria.required: measured from real riders; no passive source can establish it, so this level is not a product target
